notes.title: Wrestling With Friends
notes.content:
[h1]TIME TO WRESTLE[/h1]

Ever since we've launched the game we've been inundated with requests for a more SFW way to play the game. Now you can! We've added a setting under gameplay option to enable 'Wrestling Mode'. Now you can keep your clothes on while getting sweaty and tussling with your friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586584/afe5e7e704873f6c6773516263771f19ab12ec1f.png[/img]

Now you can perform intense (consensual) wrestling maneuvers on your friends such as Backbreakers, Rear Chin Locks, Double Leg Scissor Holds, all from a full mount position! Finally, you should also be allowed to stream the game and/or post gameplay on youtube, and god knows we can use the free marketing.  

Thanks for playing and stay safe!
